entities.name: Solomon II of Imereti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Solomon II, of the Bagrationi dynasty, was the last king (mepe) of Imereti from 1789 to 1790 and from 1792 until his deposition by the Imperial Russian government in 1810.
